### 2026-10-11 – October 10:

**2.5h**

October 10:

Today was very annoying, but my focus was working on my GitHub repository. I went through the project requirements and saw  the need for pictures in the README of my GitHub repo and the kicad/.ino files. I used assistance from Gemini for the git commands, etc., and it deleted all of the stuff that was in my repo before, only keeping what was saved locally on my device. I had to redo my whole README and fix my files.

### 2026-10-11 – October 11: Big Lock-in Day

**6.5h**

October 11: Big Lock-in Day

Today, I completed the Firmware, Gerber, and Drill files, and the BOM(Which took the longest). The firmware went pretty smoothly, and so did plotting and uploading the Gerber and Drill files, but the BOM was very annoying. This is my first Hackclub project where I had to make a BOM, and the Slack was a lot of help. Seeing JLCPCB's shipping cost be $31 was a big scare before I knew that I could change the type of shipping. But, in the end I locked in and got it all finished.
